name: Mrityu Ki Dasha Me Antyeshti Evam Anugrah Sahayata Yojana
benefit:
Funeral assistance- ₹6,000/-Ex-gratia payment-In case of normal death :
₹2,00,000/-In case of death due to accident : ₹4,00,000/-In case of permanent disability due to accident : ₹2,00,000/-In case of partial permanent disability due to accident : ₹1,00,000/-
eligibility_rules: The worker must have been registered for at least 6 months before their death. Death can be due to only natural causes or an accident. The worker must have a valid identity card. Benefit will only be provided to following successor-Wife or husband (as the case may be) of a worker holding a valid identity cardSons and unmarried and dependent daughtersDependent parentsIf there is none of the above, a family member who is dependent on the deceased worker.
documents_required: Copy of valid registration card. Prescribed application form. The death certificate and copy of FIR in case of
how_to_apply: Mode: Offline The applicant has to submit the application form in the prescribed format and within the time limit to the office of the designated officer. Rural Area - Chief Executive Officer, Janpad PanchayatUrban Area - Commissioner, Municipal Corporation/Chief Municipal Officer, Municipality/Municipal CouncilApply durationWithin 06 months from the death of the construction worker.
